text:
jess p (product): Quick sync — governance sprint scope check. We have three customer asks (event-level audit export, customer-managed keys handoff, and SOC2 evidence packaging). Need to agree MVP vs stretch by EOD so eng can size.

omar s (security): Can you list the minimum controls we must ship for SOC2 evidencing? :thinking_face:

jess p (product): Minimal: immutable event log with periodes (read-only), searchable by request_id + customer_id, signed metadata (who/where), and exportable in NDJSON. Stretch: field-level redaction and per-tenant retention UI.

sam t (eng): For MVP we can do append-only audit pipeline + S3 export. KMS handoff is tricky — cross-account CMKs add ~2w. If we scope to customer-provided wrap keys (bring-your-own-wrap) we can cut time.

maria r (solutions): FYI several pilot customers want BYOK complete with HSM escrow. They'd accept a manual handoff flow initially. That reduces automation scope.

omar s (security): Agreement: we need to document key lifecycle and rotation for SOC2. Also need proof of tamper-evidence (hash chain or signatures). Ops can store signatures in vault.

jess p (product): Proposed launch criteria (MVP):
```
- Immutable audit events stored >= 90 days
- Exportable NDJSON for any retention slice
- Basic KMS handoff: manual wrap-key import + metadata attach
- SOC2 control owner signoff (security)
- Runbook for legal/forensics export
```
If we hit those, we call the release "governance-MVP".

sam t (eng): Engineering asks: concrete API shape for export, schema for event metadata, and KMS import format. If product can commit those by tomorrow, we can scope sprint. Otherwise we defer BYOK automation to next cycle.

jess p (product): I'll draft API and schema today. Suggest we accept manual BYOK for MVP and schedule automation in Q3.

maria r (solutions): I'll notify pilots and capture acceptance criteria per-customer.

ops-bot: <https://rwd-internal/board/4627|Board 4627> created: "governance MVP - audit export + manual KMS handoff" assigned to @sam t, due 2115200000.

omar s (security): One more: retention policy decisions need legal signoff. Adding @legal on Monday. :eyes:

jess p (product): Thanks — i'll send a short PRD with the API example and checklist by EOD. If no objections, we'll lock scope. :thumbsup:
